i) The Seller fails to comply with any material term of the Contract. ii) The Seller informs Buyer of its inability to deliver the Material(s) or any part thereof within the stipulated Delivery Period or such inability otherwise becomes apparent. iii) The Seller fails to deliver the Material(s) or any part thereof within the stipulated Delivery Period and/or to replace/rectify any rejected or defective Material(s) promptly. iv) The Seller becomes bankrupt or goes into liquidation. v) The Seller makes a general assignment for the benefit of creditors. vi) A receiver is appointed for any substantial property owned by the Seller. vii) The Seller has misrepresented to Buyer, acting on which misrepresentation Buyer has placed the Purchase Order on the Seller. 7. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing Commissioning of Goods and Training of operators and providing Statutory Clearances required (if any) 8. Certificates ISO 9001: The bidder or the OEM of the offered products must have ISO 9001 certification. 9. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 10. Turnover Bidder Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. 11. Warranty Timely Servicing / rectification of defects during warranty period: After having been notified of the defects / service requirement during warranty period, Seller has to complete the required Service / Rectification within 10 days time limit. If the Seller fails to complete service / rectification with defined time limit, a penalty of 0.5% of Unit Price of the product shall be charged as penalty for each week of delay from the seller. Seller can deposit the penalty with the Buyer directly else the Buyer shall have a right to recover all such penalty amount from the Performance Security (PBG).Cumulative Penalty cannot exceed more than 10% of the total contract value after which the Buyer shall have the right to get the service / rectification done from alternate sources at the risk and cost of the Seller besides forfeiture of PBG. Seller shall be liable to re-imberse the cost of such service / rectification to the Buyer. 12. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. TEC Sample. A drone assembled using given components will be used as a sample and tested during TEC. The drone should have been assembled strictly using the specified components. Samples from all firms qualified during TEC will be retained until the award of the supply order.

The sample submitted by the successful contractor will remain deposited with the Buyer until full completion of the order, at which point it will be counted and adjusted as part of the final delivery batch. 2. Compatibility. The assembled drone during TEC must strictly utilize the exact components specified in the technical specifications. All supplied components must be fully compatible with one another. 3. Trials. Trials will be conducted on an assembled drone during TEC. The assembled drone should have been made using strictly the same components as given in technical specifications. The drone will be tested for following operational parameters. 3.1. Range - min 15 Km (one way), & Circuit of action (CoA) min 30 Km 3.2. Hover Time on target – After 15 Km (one way) min 15 minutes, safe return to start point. 3.3 Weight - Max 4.2 Kg with payload 3.4 Ceiling Height – 800m 3.5. Flight Time - During Hover minimum 56 Minutes & for Flight minimum 46 Minutes 3.6. Stability - able to sustain wind gust up to 35 Km/h 3.7. Surveillance - Both Day and Ni (Thermal Imaging without Active Illumination) 3.8. Operating temperature Range: -20°C to +55°C. 3.9. EW resilience. Capability of EW resilience (Both GNSS and RF) will be tested during TEC. 3.10. Accuracy- <3% of the Distance Travel Error (Subject to Conditions) 4. Country of Origin. Certificate to be furnished stating Country of Origin of items not from countries sharing boundary with India. 5. Pre-bid meeting.

The Pre-bid meeting is mandatory to attend. 6. Undertaking on relation with department employees. The bidders must upload an undertaking confirming that no employees of the bidders are related to any employees of the concerned department . 7. Acceptance of Terms and conditions. The bidders must confirm acceptance of all terms & conditions of the bid. 8. EFT Mandate form (Bank verified). The bidders must submit an EFT mandate form, duly verified by the bank. 9. Indigenisation and "Make in India" Compliance. Offered drone components should preferably be indigenous products, fully compliant with the Government of India’s "Make in India" / Public Procurement (Preference to Make in India) policy. The Bidder/OEM must submit an official OEM certificate confirming compliance. Preference will be given to products manufactured with 100% indigenous components. 10. Independent Supply Chain Requirement. The Bidder/OEM must ensure that the complete supply chain is fully independent and free from any dependency on any country sharing a land border with India. 11. Electronics, Avionics and Sub-system Compliance. All electronics, avionics, sensors, transmitters, receivers, communication modules and associated sub-components must be configured, sourced and supplied in full compliance with applicable Government of India guidelines, strictly avoiding any dependency on countries sharing a land border with India, wherever applicable.

12. Spare Parts and Long-Term Support. The Bidder/OEM shall provide a formal undertaking guaranteeing the availability and supply of spare parts for a minimum period of five (5) years. Additionally, the Bidder shall maintain a stock of three (3) complete sets of all items at the Buyer's premises to facilitate immediate warranty replacements and ensure uninterrupted operations. 13. Warranty. All supplied components, including hardware and software, shall carry a comprehensive warranty of 15 Months. For any component failing during the warranty period, the vendor shall provide free repair or replacement support at the user location. Warranty coverage shall not apply to damages resulting from accidents or crashes attributable to user error. Assembly by buyer will not void any component warranty. 14. Quality Assurance and Batch Integration. A technical representative of the firm shall inspect and verify the proper integration of all supplied components into the drone. Component integration shall be conducted and verified in controlled batches of fifteen (15) drones. Bidder should successfully demonstrate that each assembled drone satisfies all technical parameters specified in the bid. 15. Warranty:- Warranty period of the supplied products shall be 15 Months from the date of final accept ance of goods or after completion of installation, commissioning & testing of goods (if inclu ded in the scope of supply), at consignee location. OEM Warranty certificates must be subm itted by Successful Bidder at the time of delivery of Goods.

The seller should guarantee the rectification of goods in case of any break down during the guarantee period. Seller should have well established Installation, Commissioning, Training, Troubleshooting and Maintena nce Service group in INDIA for attending the after sales service. Details of Service Centres n ear consignee destinations are to be uploaded along with the bid. . 13. Inspection Nominated Inspection Agency: On behalf of the Buyer organization, any one of the following Inspection Agency would be conducting inspection of stores before acceptance: Pre-dispatch Inspection at Seller Premises (applicable only if pre-dispatch inspection clause has been selected in ATC): Nil Post Receipt Inspection at consignee site before acceptance of stores: Nominated Board of Officers 14. Generic Actual delivery (and Installation & Commissioning (if covered in scope of supply)) is to be done at following address 616 EME Batalian Sadhuwali Cantt Sri Ganganagar Rajasthan PIN-335001 . 15. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 16. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Fixed Deposit Receipt made out or pledged in the name of A/C

Regimental Account 616 EME Bn . The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of EMD, the FDR will be released in the favour of the bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Bidder has to upload scanned copy/ proof of the FDR along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date/ Bid Opening date 17. Generic Staggered Delivery: The ordered items shall be supplied in a staggered manner. ( 15 Quantity shall be supplied within 9 days of contract placement and thereafter 15 Quantity per Week) 18. Generic Scope of supply includes Training: Number of employees to be trained 15 , Place for Training Sri Ganganagar, Rajasthan and Duration of training 15 days. 19. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 20. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 21. Generic Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting. Buyer will not take any responsibility in this regards. GST reimbursement will be as per actuals or as per applicable rates (whichever is lower), subject to the maximum of quoted GST %.
